messages:
alina.sales: Equinox wants a hosted API key for a 7-day evaluation next week. Requirements: embed+generate scopes, TTL 7d, allowed IPs 18.205.33.0/24, and explicit revocation steps for their infosec. Can we provision and document the flows?

rohan.eng: We can spin up a scoped short-lived key. Recommend using the Keys API so we can script creation + rotation and attach notes for audit. Example payload (placeholders):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"equinox-poc-1","scopes":["inference:generate","embeddings:create"],"allowed_ips":["18.205.33.0/24"],"expires_at":"2026-03-30T18:00:00Z","notes":"POC - Equinox"}'
```

rohan.eng: Revocation options: Console toggle, PATCH {"revoked":true}, or DELETE. All actions create audit events. TTLs: POC max 30d, so 7d fine.

tess.security: Need two things for their questionnaire: 1) where audits live and retention; 2) guarantee of immediate invalidation on revoke.

rohan.eng: Audit events show in Console -> Activity and in tenant audit exports (S3 path if enabled). Default retention 90 days for hosted. Revocation sets a revoke flag in the auth check so tokens are invalid immediately; we log actor, IP, and request id.

alina.sales: Can you create the key and DM me the masked token + key_id so I can send to the customer? Also add a note that we will auto-rotate once mid-run (day 3) and revoke old token.

ops-bot: Key creation request received.

rohan.eng: Created key: key_id kid_f1d2e3. Masked token: sk-****b1c3. Expires: 2026-03-30T18:00:00Z. Allowed IPs: [18.205.33.0/24]. Audit event: evt_20260323_770 logged.

tess.security: Please set a single automated rotate at day 3 and ensure the rotation links both key IDs in the same audit trace. Also include KMS note: hosted uses Redwood-managed KMS; enterprise can request BYOK integration.

rohan.eng: Rotation job scheduled for 2026-03-27T18:00:00Z (one run). Rotation flow: create new key, send new token to designated contact, revoke old key, attach rotation record to evt_20260323_770 -> rot_20260327_01.

alina.sales: Great. I'll share sk-****b1c3 and allowed IP to Equinox and attach the audit export path if they request it. Thanks! :thumbsup:
